name: Apostate
description: The Apostate was a starship owned by the bounty hunter Nik Hepho. While Hepho was searching for adherents of the Church of the Force in Jedha City on the moon Jedha in the year 1 BBY, the ship hovered in orbit above, operated by a droid intelligence that waited for the hunter to make contact via his backpack-mounted long-range transmitter.
